entities.summary: Christian Davon Kirk is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League. He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the second round of the 2018 NFL draft. Kirk has also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and Houston Texans.
